# Address resolver contract (2026-11-14): replaces the 28 fixed `RVA_*` defines in kcd_dlss.c

Goal: the plugin must find every address by itself on any store build of WHGame.dll (Steam, GOG, Epic) of the
same game version. No fixed RVA is used at run time any more. Stock Steam DLL for reference and offline proof:
a stock Steam 1.9.8 `WHGame.dll` (sha256 cf9f6dc3..., image base 0x180000000). Read only.

## Generated header `addr_sig.h` (written by `gen_addr.py`, consumed by kcd_dlss.c)

```c
/* generated by gen_addr.py: do not edit */
enum { A_RENDERER, A_VT_UPSCALE, /* ... one per old RVA_ define, same name with A_ instead of RVA_ ... */ A_COUNT };
#define ADDR_STEAM_STAMP 0x........u        /* FileHeader.TimeDateStamp of the Steam DLL the table was proven on */
#define ADDR_STEAM_IMAGE 0x........u        /* its OptionalHeader.SizeOfImage */
static const char *const addr_name[A_COUNT] = { "RENDERER", ... };
static const unsigned int addr_steam_rva[A_COUNT] = { 0x34c6980u, ... };   /* self-check on the Steam build only */

enum { AK_DATA, AK_CODE, AK_VTSLOT, AK_VTFUNC };
struct addr_ent {
    unsigned char id;        /* A_... ; several entries may share an id (independent witnesses) */
    unsigned char kind;
    unsigned short len;      /* bytes in sig/mask (0 = none) */
    int off;                 /* AK_DATA: offset of the disp32 inside the match. AK_CODE: target = match + off (may be negative).
                                AK_VTSLOT / AK_VTFUNC: slot index in the class's primary vtable */
    int tail;                /* AK_DATA: bytes between the end of the disp32 and the end of the instruction (immediate size) */
    const char *cls;         /* AK_VTSLOT / AK_VTFUNC: decorated RTTI type name, e.g. ".?AVCSystem@@"; else NULL */
    const unsigned char *sig, *mask;   /* mask byte 1 = must match, 0 = wildcard. sig[0], sig[1] always have mask 1 */
};
static const struct addr_ent addr_tab[] = { ... };
#define ADDR_TAB_N (sizeof addr_tab / sizeof addr_tab[0])
```

## Meaning of each kind (run time)
- AK_DATA: scan WHGame.dll's code section for sig/mask. Exactly one hit needed. target = hit + off + 4 + tail + *(int32 *)(hit + off).
- AK_CODE: same scan, exactly one hit. target = hit + off.
- AK_VTSLOT: find the vtable of class `cls` through MSVC RTTI (type descriptor by name -> complete object locator with
  offset 0 -> the qword pointing at that locator sits at vtable[-1]). target = &vtable[off]. No sig.
- AK_VTFUNC: target = vtable[off] (the function). If len > 0, the bytes at the target must match sig/mask (a compare,
  not a scan): this is the "is it really that function" check that replaces the old "slot == base + RVA" tests.

## Combining witnesses
For one id, every entry that resolves is a vote. Result = the common target when at least one entry resolved and all
resolved entries agree; otherwise unresolved (NULL). A sig with 0 or 2+ hits simply gives no vote.

## Rules for the signatures (generator)
- Wildcard every rip-relative disp32 and every call/jmp/jcc rel32. Keep opcodes, registers, stack and struct offsets.
- Each sig must hit exactly once in the Steam DLL's code section and resolve to the old RVA.
- Aim for 3 witnesses per id taken from different functions (2 is acceptable, 1 only when nothing else references it).
- Prefer short, plain code (20-40 fixed bytes) in functions that are unlikely to differ between store builds
  (render/engine code, not Steam/online/achievement code).

## Field evidence (Nexus, 2026-11-12, Epic build `Win64MasterMasterEpicPGO`, plugin 0.8.1)
- WHGame.dll image size 0x39e5000, build stamp 0x69ccdca1, file 47,870,976 B (Steam file: 47,896,576 B).
- The grass signature hit once at WHGame.dll+0x523186 (Steam: +0x522f96, so +0x1f0) and the sharpen signature hit once:
  the compiled code is the same, only shifted. Fixed-RVA checks all failed (the CSystem vtable RVA pointed into text
  data, slot read back 0x676e696e).
- GOG 1.9.8 fails the same three fixed-RVA checks.
